lessons.title: Practice Window Functions
lessons.description: For each department, rank employees by salary descending with ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC). Name that column rank. The test checks that you return at least 5 rows and a column named rank.
lessons.starter_code:
-- TODO: add rank = ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC)
SELECT first_name, department, salary FROM employees WHERE 0;
lessons.solution_code: SELECT first_name, department, salary, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY department ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rank FROM employees;
